**Sleep 모드**에서는 CPU 클럭만 멈추고 주변장치(타이머, UA: In **Sleep mode** only the CPU clock stops; the peripherals (timers, UART) keep running. When an interrupt comes, execution continues from the next instruction.
더 깊은 **Stop/Standby** 모드는 클럭까지 끄고 µA 단위로: The deeper **Stop/Standby** modes turn off clocks as well and get down to the µA range, but waking up takes time and some peripherals stop.
잠든 비율은 TIM5(1 MHz, 계속 도는 32비트 타이머)로 WFI: The asleep fraction is calculated by timing before and after WFI with TIM5 (1 MHz, a free-running 32-bit timer).
SysTick을 그대로 두고 WFI — 1 ms마다 깨어나 잠든 효과가: WFI with SysTick left running — it wakes every 1 ms, which cuts the benefit of sleeping.
WFI with no interrupt enabled at all — it never wakes up.
